machine_report: Three paired encoder seeds on one additional month constitute a screen, not general-purpose superiority.
January was repeatedly used and remains development evidence; March comparisons are within the new paired arms.
February was already consumed by V15 and is not fresh confirmation for V16; March becomes observed evidence after this declared study.
Head repetitions are not independent encoder or market-population replications.
Saved-fit arithmetic is independently reconstructed; encoder forwards and optimizer trajectories are not independently reimplemented.
Temporal witnesses audit only updates1/2048 and direct output adjoints, not the full encoder Jacobian, every remaining training update or full global-clip norm.
Value/temporal direct routes share one global clip1 and AdamW; objective components are not optimization-independent.
Training fixed-query waveform witnesses cover first8 examples only; full112/32 saved row reductions are checked without claiming full waveform reconstruction.
Conditional bootstrap intervals from the frozen producer are retained but are not independently audited.
Past-window readout, reconstruction and TEMPO do not establish forecasting, interventions or downstream decision utility.
limitations.confirmation_now_consumed: March2024 is now observed evidence for this fixed study; any later recipe chosen after these results needs a newly declared confirmation population. February was already consumed by V15.
limitations.temporal_evidence: Temporal waveform/support/direct-output-adjoint audit covers updates1/2048, not every intervening update, the full encoder Jacobian or a reconstructed global clipping norm.
limitations.optimization: V4 Gaussian mean/variance routes and auxiliary mean route share one global clip1 and AdamW; no optimization independence is claimed.
limitations.integrity: This helper only hashes/parses explicit metadata/prose/source. It does not decode tensors/caches, read Linux executables, rerun native audits, fit heads, evaluate models, recalculate metrics or establish forecasts. Final metadata rechecks are not an atomic snapshot against concurrent writers.
limitations.historical_counts: The original22 objects and saved flags are copied, not re-evaluated. Earlier V4 19/22 used different floors and cannot be ranked by this count.
limitations.preservation: Original source, binaries, completed trajectories and all interrupted raw bytes are retained. Two canonical CSV identities changed under the explicit recovery publication; original bytes remain at hash-bound retained aliases. Missing final artifacts were added. No deletion, commit, publication, promotion or new scientific recipe follows.
limitations.operational_recovery: Candidate946103 restored its own fixed typed512 state and recomputed discarded continuation. Exact physical repetitions and whole-trajectory cost/per-parameter prefix counters remain unknown. New actual recovery executable and two canonical CSV identity changes are explicitly bound. Parameter learning evidence covers suffix513..2048 only.
